# Optional Ponytail Review Pilot Implementation Plan

## Scope and authority

Task `T-18db6175-499f-4679-bf8d-f815c7b42411` integrates the exact original Ponytail skill as an optional bounded contribution. The source-backed Codex invocation and W1 core decisions remain the qualified execution mechanisms. Core-only installation retains zero external packages and bindings. The task creates no remote publication, actual project plugin installation consent, candidate comparison or merge authority.

## Research and source identity

The source descriptor pins `DietrichGebert/ponytail` revision `96608e078b2d5ea607c5c3b8b5a54d1c1fba6846`, entry `skills/ponytail/SKILL.md` and the inspected MIT license. PR readiness inspects configured current review obligations as well as attached chain references. An enabled but never-started occurrence cannot disappear from readiness. During contributes after core inspection while preserving the complete core result. Before may contribute before core review without satisfying core review. Exact head/base/target, current configuration, source/resources, capabilities and ordinary invocation receipts remain binding. Frozen obligations survive configuration changes until explicit supported reconciliation records the change.

Returned findings enter ordinary W1 substantiation or evidence-backed dismissal, authorized fixes, required checks and repeated full review. Any additional actual-host pilot requires a separately recorded finite functional qualification plan; comparative calibration/trials remain behind task114 actual owner agreement.
